title: Playing with Tommy Ridgley and quitting in 1969
summary: He disbanded in 1967, helped Tommy Ridgley on piano, and last played on New Year's night 1969.

bands.name: Sugar Boy and His Cane Cutters

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Until, let's see, around 60 with my band. Until around 67. Yeah. And then around the end of 67, I started playing with Tommy Ridgely. I stopped playing with my band. I said, well, I'm going to give it up. I wasn't making no money. So, I gave it up. And Tommy Ridgely, he said he wanted some help. He's still playing. So, he asked me about helping him out. I gave him some of my arrangements, maybe coming to the rehearsal, you know, if we had time. So, I ended up playing with him. I ended up playing piano with him. And I stopped playing with him in 69. New Year's night, 1969 was the last time I played. And I said, I'm finished with it.
New Year's Eve or New Year's Day?
New Year's night. New Year's night. On the first of January, 1969. Why'd you come to that decision on that day?
